# @quran-lab/tajweedformer 2.0.1 (vendored)

Quran Lab's TajweedFormer web SDK, copied unmodified from `npm pack @quran-lab/tajweedformer@2.0.1`
(licence NPL-1.2, see LICENSE). The Flask pages have no bundler, so the package's own ES modules are served from here and
resolved through an import map in `templates/index.html`. To upgrade: `scripts/vendor_tajweedformer.sh <version>`.
Skill and rules: https://portal.quranlab.ai/skills/quranlab-sdk/SKILL.md
